definitions.explanation: Any form of life, including animals, plants, and microorganisms.
The study of living organisms, commonly abbreviated in Japanese schools.

examples.japanese: {海|うみ}には{様々|さまざま}な{生物|せいぶつ}がいる。
examples.english: There are various creatures in the sea.

examples.japanese: {生物|せいぶつ}の{授業|じゅぎょう}
{微|び}{生物|せいぶつ}を{研究|けんきゅう}する。

notes:
{生物|せいぶつ} is composed of {生|せい} (life) + {物|ぶつ} (thing).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {生物|せいぶつ}{学|がく}: biology (formal)
- {微|び}{生物|せいぶつ}: microorganism
- {生物|せいぶつ}{多様性|たようせい}: biodiversity
- {海洋|かいよう}{生物|せいぶつ}: marine life

VS. {生|い}き{物|もの}:
- {生物|せいぶつ}: technical/scientific term
- {生|い}き{物|もの}: everyday term for living things
